title: Bound configured Multi-Site collections before runtime route binding

opportunity.rootCause: The IConfiguration validation path bounded total Sites but did not bound Hostnames, PathPrefixes, or Upstreams per Site. The typed snapshot path already had these limits, so configuration-backed startup could expand route and destination state before reaching the shared runtime snapshot gate.
opportunity.risk: A malformed or oversized configuration could create excessive route, destination, and health-probe work during binding and activation.

implementation.behavior: Configuration validation now rejects oversized per-Site collections before SiteConfigurationLoader binds runtime routes, using the same cardinality limits as ValidateSnapshot.

red.result: failed 1/1 because configuration validation returned no per-Site cardinality errors

verification.multiSiteRegression: passed 259/259 across 99 executable test classes; external PostgreSQL fault-injection and non-test filename placeholders were not executable suite classes

boundary: PostgreSQL-backed integration and live database oversized-configuration execution were not run in this environment
Authenticated browser and published-EXE smoke were not run
